caption:
You don't hate automation. You hate getting billed for it in month four when nobody remembers the password.

That instinct is fair. Most service businesses carry at least one tool still charging their card that the team stopped opening months ago.

Before you sign anything new, pull up your bank statement. List every recurring software charge. Circle the ones nobody on your team opened this week. That list is your real automation cost.

The Black Arrow platform runs the opposite way: 14 days free, no card needed, cancel anytime. Watch your own leads move through it before you commit anything.
